"Build a complete Roblox Survival Island game development project.

Game Title: Survival Island

Game Concept:
Create an exciting multiplayer survival game set on a beautiful tropical island.

World Design:

- Large tropical island surrounded by a realistic ocean.
- Dense forests, mountains, caves, beaches and rivers.
- Detailed trees, rocks, plants and environmental objects.
- Dynamic day and night cycle.
- Beautiful lighting, shadows and atmospheric effects.

Gameplay Systems:

1. Player resource gathering: wood, stone, food and water.
2. Crafting system for tools and equipment.
3. House and base building system.
4. Player health, hunger and thirst.
5. Inventory with a beautiful user interface.
6. In-game shop and currency.
7. Missions, rewards and achievements.
8. Multiplayer support.
9. Persistent player data saving.
10. Mobile-friendly controls.

Technical Requirements:

- Use Roblox Luau scripting.
- Organize scripts into ServerScriptService, ReplicatedStorage and StarterGui.
- Use secure server-side validation for player actions.
- Implement DataStoreService for saving player progress.
- Create reusable and modular scripts.
- Optimize performance for mobile devices.

Deliverables:

- Complete source code.
- All scripts with their correct Roblox locations.
- Detailed map construction instructions.
- Installation and testing instructions.
- Do not provide pseudocode or incomplete examples.
- Build the project in organized stages and verify each system before proceeding.

The final result should be a polished, playable Roblox survival game, not just a visual mockup.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

--!strict
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStoreName)
local profiles: {[Player]: any} = {}

local function clone(value: any): any
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local result = {}
	for key, child in pairs(value) do result[key] = clone(child) end
	return result
end

local function sanitize(raw: any): any
	local profile = clone(Config.DefaultProfile)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then return profile end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Health", "Hunger", "Thirst" }) do
		if type(raw[key]) == "number" then profile[key] = math.clamp(raw[key], 0, 100) end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Shells", "XP", "Level" }) do
		if type(raw[key]) == "number" then profile[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(raw[key]), 0, 1000000) end
	end
	if type(raw.Inventory) == "table" then
		for item in pairs(profile.Inventory) do
			local amount = raw.Inventory[item]
			if type(amount) == "number" then profile.Inventory[item] = math.clamp(math.floor(amount), 0, Config.MaxInventory) end
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Crafted", "Buildings", "Missions" }) do
		if type(raw[key]) == "table" then
			for id, value in pairs(raw[key]) do
				if type(id) == "string" and (type(value) == "boolean" or type(value) == "number") then profile[key][id] = value end
			end
		end
	end
	return profile
end

function DataService.Load(player: Player): any
	local key = "player_" .. player.UserId
	local success, result = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync(key) end)
	if not success then warn("[SurvivalIsland] Data load failed for", player.UserId, result) end
	local profile = sanitize(if success then result else nil)
	profiles[player] = profile
	return profile
end

function DataService.Get(player: Player): any?
	return profiles[player]
end

function DataService.Save(player: Player): boolean
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile then return false end
	local snapshot = clone(profile)
	local success, message = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, function() return snapshot end)
	end)
	if not success then warn("[SurvivalIsland] Data save failed for", player.UserId, message) end
	return success
end

function DataService.Remove(player: Player)
	profiles[player] = nil
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	DataService.Save(player)
	DataService.Remove(player)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		DataService.Save(player)
	end
end)

return DataService

--!strict
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local WorldService = {}
local resourceFolder: Folder

local function part(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material, shape: Enum.PartType?): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name, p.Size, p.Position, p.Color, p.Material = name, size, position, color, material
	p.Anchored, p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = true, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if shape then p.Shape = shape end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function makeResource(kind: string, position: Vector3, index: number)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = kind .. string.format("_%02d", index)
	model:SetAttribute("ResourceType", kind)
	model:SetAttribute("Health", Config.Resources[kind].Health)
	model:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", Config.Resources[kind].Health)
	model:SetAttribute("ResourceIndex", index)
	local root: Part
	if kind == "Tree" or kind == "Palm" then
		root = part(model, "Trunk", Vector3.new(2.4, 17, 2.4), position + Vector3.new(0, 8.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(112, 82, 52), Enum.Material.Wood)
		root.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		if kind == "Palm" then
			local crown = part(model, "PalmCrown", Vector3.new(13, 3, 13), position + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0), Color3.fromRGB(68, 139, 75), Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
			crown.CanCollide = false
		else
			local crown = part(model, "Canopy", Vector3.new(13, 12, 13), position + Vector3.new(0, 17, 0), Color3.fromRGB(55, 119, 62), Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
			crown.CanCollide = false
		end
	elseif kind == "Rock" then
		root = part(model, "Rock", Vector3.new(8, 6, 7), position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(123, 132, 117), Enum.Material.Rock, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	elseif kind == "Bush" then
		root = part(model, "BerryBush", Vector3.new(7, 5, 7), position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(68, 140, 70), Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		local berries = part(model, "Berries", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), position + Vector3.new(1, 4, -2), Color3.fromRGB(177, 82, 128), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		berries.CanCollide = false
	else
		root = part(model, "Spring", Vector3.new(9, 0.6, 9), position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(89, 190, 188), Enum.Material.Glass, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		root.Transparency = 0.2
	end
	root.Name = "ResourceRoot"
	root:SetAttribute("IsResourceRoot", true)
	root.CanCollide = kind == "Rock"
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
	model.Parent = resourceFolder
	CollectionService:AddTag(model, "SurvivalResource")
end

local function islandPosition(rng: Random): Vector3
	local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
	local radius = math.sqrt(rng:NextNumber(0.06, 0.88)) * 300
	return Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius * 0.72)
end

function WorldService.Initialize()
	local terrain = Workspace.Terrain
	terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(0, -18, 0), Vector3.new(2048, 32, 2048), Enum.Material.Water)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(0, -16, 0), 355, Enum.Material.Sand)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), 327, Enum.Material.Grass)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(35, 18, -55), 86, Enum.Material.Ground)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(35, 40, -55), 65, Enum.Material.Rock)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(-105, 12, 20), 56, Enum.Material.Ground)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(-105, 29, 20), 39, Enum.Material.Rock)
	terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(8, -2, 148), Vector3.new(16, 5, 210), Enum.Material.Water)
	resourceFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	resourceFolder.Name = "IslandResources"
	resourceFolder.Parent = Workspace
	local rng = Random.new(72024)
	local kinds = { Tree = 70, Palm = 24, Rock = 24, Bush = 28, Spring = 5 }
	local index = 0
	for kind, amount in pairs(kinds) do
		for _ = 1, amount do
			index += 1
			local pos = islandPosition(rng)
			if kind == "Spring" then pos += Vector3.new(0, 0, -20) end
			makeResource(kind, pos, index)
		end
	end
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name, spawn.Size, spawn.Position = "BeachSpawn", Vector3.new(18, 1, 18), Vector3.new(0, 1, 265)
	spawn.Anchored, spawn.Neutral, spawn.Material = true, true, Enum.Material.Sand
	spawn.Color = Color3.fromRGB(224, 204, 148)
	spawn.Parent = Workspace
	Lighting.ClockTime = 8
	Lighting.Brightness = 2
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(116, 135, 125)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(153, 170, 156)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.35
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.45
	local atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
	atmosphere.Density, atmosphere.Offset = 0.25, 0.12
	atmosphere.Color, atmosphere.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(197, 230, 219), Color3.fromRGB(95, 151, 156)
	atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
	local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
	bloom.Intensity, bloom.Size, bloom.Threshold = 0.18, 24, 1.2
	bloom.Parent = Lighting
end

function WorldService.GetResourceFolder(): Folder
	return resourceFolder
end

function WorldService.RespawnResource(model: Model)
	if not model.Parent then return end
	local kind = model:GetAttribute("ResourceType")
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or not Config.Resources[kind] then return end
	model:SetAttribute("Health", Config.Resources[kind].Health)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then descendant.Transparency = 0; descendant.CanQuery = true end
	end
end

function WorldService.SetResourceDepleted(model: Model)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then descendant.Transparency = 0.72; descendant.CanQuery = false end
	end
end

return WorldService

--!strict
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Data = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local World = require(script.Parent.WorldService)
local GameService = {}
local lastAction: {[Player]: number} = {}
local remotes: Folder
local stateEvent: RemoteEvent

local function rootOf(player: Player): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	return if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
end

local function inventoryUsed(profile: any): number
	local total = 0
	for _, amount in pairs(profile.Inventory) do total += amount end
	return total
end

local function sendState(player: Player, message: string?)
	local profile = Data.Get(player)
	if not profile or not stateEvent then return end
	stateEvent:FireClient(player, {
		Inventory = profile.Inventory, Health = profile.Health, Hunger = profile.Hunger,
		Thirst = profile.Thirst, Shells = profile.Shells, Level = profile.Level,
		XP = profile.XP, Crafted = profile.Crafted, Buildings = profile.Buildings,
		Missions = profile.Missions, Gathered = profile.Gathered, Message = message,
	})
end

local function message(player: Player, text: string)
	sendState(player, text)
end

local function addXP(profile: any, amount: number)
	profile.XP += amount
	while profile.XP >= 100 do
		profile.XP -= 100
		profile.Level += 1
	end
end

local function canAfford(profile: any, cost: {[string]: number}): boolean
	for item, amount in pairs(cost) do
		if (profile.Inventory[item] or 0) < amount then return false end
	end
	return true
end

local function pay(profile: any, cost: {[string]: number})
	for item, amount in pairs(cost) do profile.Inventory[item] -= amount end
end

local function tryGather(player: Player, target: any)
	if typeof(target) ~= "Instance" or not target:IsA("Model") or not CollectionService:HasTag(target, "SurvivalResource") then return end
	if not target:IsDescendantOf(World.GetResourceFolder()) or target:GetAttribute("Health") == nil or target:GetAttribute("Health") <= 0 then return end
	local root = rootOf(player)
	local resourceRoot = target.PrimaryPart
	if not root or not resourceRoot or (root.Position - resourceRoot.Position).Magnitude > 20 then return end
	local profile = Data.Get(player)
	local kind = target:GetAttribute("ResourceType")
	local definition = if type(kind) == "string" then Config.Resources[kind] else nil
	if not profile or not definition then return end
	local amount = definition.Amount
	local current = profile.Inventory[definition.Item] or 0
	if inventoryUsed(profile) >= Config.MaxInventory then message(player, "Your pack is full. Make room before gathering more."); return end
	if definition.Item == "Wood" and profile.Crafted.StoneAxe then amount *= 2 end
	profile.Inventory[definition.Item] = math.min(Config.MaxInventory - inventoryUsed(profile) + current, current + amount)
	profile.Gathered[definition.Item] = (profile.Gathered[definition.Item] or 0) + amount
	profile.Health = math.clamp(profile.Health + (definition.Item == "Berries" and 0 or 0), 0, 100)
	local damage = if profile.Crafted.StoneAxe and kind == "Tree" then 2 else 1
	local remaining = math.max(0, target:GetAttribute("Health") - damage)
	target:SetAttribute("Health", remaining)
	addXP(profile, 5)
	if definition.Item == "Berries" then profile.Hunger = math.min(100, profile.Hunger + 12) end
	if definition.Item == "Coconut" then profile.Hunger = math.min(100, profile.Hunger + 5); profile.Thirst = math.min(100, profile.Thirst + 18) end
	if definition.Item == "Water" then profile.Thirst = math.min(100, profile.Thirst + 10) end
	if remaining <= 0 then
		World.SetResourceDepleted(target)
		task.delay(Config.ResourceRespawnSeconds, function()
			if target.Parent then World.RespawnResource(target) end
		end)
	end
	message(player, string.format("+%d %s", amount, definition.Item))
end

local function craft(player: Player, recipeId: any)
	if type(recipeId) ~= "string" or #recipeId > 30 then return end
	local profile, recipe = Data.Get(player), Config.Recipes[recipeId]
	if not profile or not recipe then return end
	if profile.Crafted[recipeId] then message(player, "You already made that tool."); return end
	if not canAfford(profile, recipe.Cost) then message(player, "You don't have the ingredients for that yet."); return end
	pay(profile, recipe.Cost)
	profile.Crafted[recipeId] = true
	addXP(profile, 15)
	message(player, recipeId .. " crafted! Check your inventory.")
end

local function build(player: Player, buildingId: any)
	if type(buildingId) ~= "string" or #buildingId > 30 then return end
	local profile, definition = Data.Get(player), Config.Buildings[buildingId]
	local root = rootOf(player)
	if not profile or not definition or not root then return end
	if profile.Buildings[buildingId] then message(player, "You have already built that."); return end
	if math.abs(root.Position.X) > Config.IslandRadius or math.abs(root.Position.Z) > Config.IslandRadius then return end
	if not canAfford(profile, definition.Cost) then message(player, "Gather more materials before you build."); return end
	pay(profile, definition.Cost)
	profile.Buildings[buildingId] = true
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = player.Name .. "_" .. buildingId
	local ground = Instance.new("Part")
	ground.Name, ground.Anchored, ground.Size = "Floor", true, Vector3.new(12, 0.6, 10)
	ground.Material, ground.Color = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color3.fromRGB(142, 111, 73)
	ground.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, 7.5, root.Position.Z)
	ground.Parent = model
	if buildingId == "LeanTo" then
		for _, offset in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local beam = Instance.new("WedgePart")
			beam.Name, beam.Anchored, beam.Size = "PalmRoof", true, Vector3.new(7, 9, 12)
			beam.Material, beam.Color = Enum.Material.Wood, Color3.fromRGB(112, 137, 77)
			beam.CFrame = ground.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset * 2.8, 4.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(offset * 24))
			beam.Parent = model
		end
	else
		local fire = Instance.new("Part")
		fire.Name, fire.Shape, fire.Size = "Campfire", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5)
		fire.Anchored, fire.Material, fire.Color = true, Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(255, 143, 59)
		fire.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		fire.Parent = model
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = Color3.fromRGB(255, 159, 83), 18, 1.5
		light.Parent = fire
	end
	model.Parent = Workspace
	profile.Health = math.min(100, profile.Health + definition.Health)
	addXP(profile, 20)
	message(player, buildingId .. " built! Your new base is right here.")
end

local function consume(player: Player, item: string)
	local profile = Data.Get(player)
	if not profile or (profile.Inventory[item] or 0) < 1 then message(player, "You don't have any " .. item .. "."); return end
	profile.Inventory[item] -= 1
	if item == "Berries" then profile.Hunger = math.min(100, profile.Hunger + 25)
	elseif item == "Coconut" then profile.Hunger = math.min(100, profile.Hunger + 12); profile.Thirst = math.min(100, profile.Thirst + 25)
	elseif item == "Water" then profile.Thirst = math.min(100, profile.Thirst + 30)
	else return end
	message(player, item .. " used. You're feeling better.")
end

local function shop(player: Player, action: any)
	local profile = Data.Get(player)
	if not profile or type(action) ~= "string" then return end
	if action == "SellWood" then
		if (profile.Inventory.Wood or 0) < 3 then message(player, "You need 3 wood to trade."); return end
		profile.Inventory.Wood -= 3
		profile.Shells += 10
		message(player, "+10 shells. A good trade!")
	elseif action == "BuyBerries" and profile.Shells >= 12 then
		profile.Shells -= 12
		profile.Inventory.Berries = math.min(Config.MaxInventory, profile.Inventory.Berries + 2)
		message(player, "Bought a handful of berries.")
	elseif action == "BuyWater" and profile.Shells >= 15 then
		profile.Shells -= 15
		profile.Inventory.Water = math.min(Config.MaxInventory, profile.Inventory.Water + 1)
		message(player, "Bought fresh water.")
	else message(player, "You need more shells for that.") end
end

local function claimMission(player: Player, missionId: any)
	if type(missionId) ~= "string" or #missionId > 40 then return end
	local profile, mission = Data.Get(player), Config.Missions[missionId]
	if not profile or not mission or profile.Missions[missionId] then return end
	if (profile.Gathered[mission.Item] or 0) < mission.Goal then message(player, "Keep exploring to finish this mission."); return end
	profile.Missions[missionId] = true
	profile.Shells += mission.Reward
	addXP(profile, 25)
	message(player, "Mission complete! +" .. mission.Reward .. " shells.")
end

function GameService.Initialize(remoteFolder: Folder)
	remotes = remoteFolder
	stateEvent = remoteFolder:WaitForChild("State") :: RemoteEvent
	local actionEvent = remoteFolder:WaitForChild("Action") :: RemoteEvent
	actionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: any, payload: any)
		if type(action) ~= "string" or #action > 24 then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (lastAction[player] or 0) < Config.ActionCooldown then return end
		lastAction[player] = now
		if action == "Gather" then tryGather(player, payload)
		elseif action == "Craft" then craft(player, payload)
		elseif action == "Build" then build(player, payload)
		elseif action == "Eat" then consume(player, "Berries")
		elseif action == "Drink" then consume(player, "Water")
		elseif action == "UseCoconut" then consume(player, "Coconut")
		elseif action == "Shop" then shop(player, payload)
		elseif action == "ClaimMission" then claimMission(player, payload)
		elseif action == "RequestState" then sendState(player) end
	end)
	for _, resource in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("SurvivalResource")) do
		local prompt = resource.PrimaryPart and resource.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
		if prompt then prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) tryGather(player, resource) end) end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		local profile = Data.Load(player)
		player:SetAttribute("IslandDataLoaded", true)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
			if humanoid then humanoid.MaxHealth = 100; humanoid.Health = profile.Health end
			task.wait(0.5)
			sendState(player)
		end)
		if player.Character then task.defer(function() sendState(player) end) end
	end)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(function() local p=Data.Load(player); task.wait(0.5); sendState(player) end) end
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(12)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local profile = Data.Get(player)
				if profile then
					profile.Hunger = math.max(0, profile.Hunger - 0.55)
					profile.Thirst = math.max(0, profile.Thirst - 0.85)
					if profile.Hunger <= 0 or profile.Thirst <= 0 then
						profile.Health = math.max(5, profile.Health - 2)
					else profile.Health = math.min(100, profile.Health + 0.2) end
					local character = player.Character
					local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if humanoid then humanoid.Health = profile.Health end
					sendState(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.DayLengthSeconds / 24)
			game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = (game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime + 1) % 24
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do task.wait(Config.SaveIntervalSeconds); for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do Data.Save(player) end end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) lastAction[player] = nil end)
end

return GameService

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “Survival Island” game project with Roblox Luau source, secure server-side systems, persistent data, map setup, and installation/testing documentation.
- The user requested staged implementation and verification, with no clarification questions.

## Requirements
- Multiplayer tropical survival gameplay: gathering, crafting, building, health/hunger/thirst, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements, data persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Organize Roblox scripts in `ServerScriptService`, `ReplicatedStorage`, and `StarterGui`; use modular Luau and secure server validation.
- Deliver complete source, map construction instructions, and installation/testing instructions; avoid pseudocode or incomplete examples.

## Decisions
- The repository was effectively empty, so work began on both a polished browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Browser prototype uses HTML canvas, responsive UI, local-storage saves, and keyboard/touch controls; Roblox implementation uses server-authoritative gameplay and generated island assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created browser prototype shell, responsive UI, map rendering, gathering/crafting/building/missions/shop interactions, survival stats, and local saves in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Created Rojo project config and Roblox modules for configuration, DataStore persistence, generated island/resources, and server-side gameplay/actions.
- Configured Roblox data defaults and persisted lifetime gathering counters for missions.

### Active
- Continue Roblox implementation: create server bootstrap and `StarterGui` client UI; complete resource gathering/crafting/building/shop/missions interactions.
- Fix/check world generation details and validate the browser prototype.
- Add detailed README with Roblox Studio installation, map guidance, DataStore setup, and testing instructions; verify systems and capture a screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue editing `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua`; remove or review the `model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))` call because resource parts already have world positions, and set spawn placement correctly.
2. Finish server bootstrap/remote creation, resource prompt connections, and fix bushes so Fiber can be gathered for currently-unreachable recipes/builds.
3. Build the `StarterGui` LocalScript UI and wire it to server remotes for inventory, crafting, building, missions, shop, and consumption.
4. Add installation/map/testing documentation, then run available checks and inspect a current screenshot of the browser prototype.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Browser game interface and main UI structure.
- `style.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `game.js`: Browser prototype simulation and interactions.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.

- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua`: Generated island, resources, prompts, and lighting.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-validated actions, survival, missions, crafting, buildings, and shop.

## Important Context
- Roblox code is not yet complete; there is no server bootstrap, remotes setup, or client GUI script yet.
- `WorldService.lua` currently positions resource parts and then calls `model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))`, which may shift them unexpectedly.
- Fiber is required by several recipes/buildings but no resource currently yields it.
- Work has not been committed.

--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SurvivalIslandRemotes")
local actionEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("Action") :: RemoteEvent
local stateEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("State") :: RemoteEvent
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local COLORS = {
	background = Color3.fromRGB(13, 30, 34), panel = Color3.fromRGB(23, 48, 49), card = Color3.fromRGB(31, 62, 60),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 218), muted = Color3.fromRGB(166, 188, 167), accent = Color3.fromRGB(211, 226, 151),
	button = Color3.fromRGB(101, 138, 82), danger = Color3.fromRGB(188, 113, 86),
}
local inventoryNames = { "Wood", "Stone", "Berries", "Coconut", "Water", "Fiber" }
local itemIcons = { Wood = "🪵", Stone = "🪨", Berries = "🫐", Coconut = "🥥", Water = "💧", Fiber = "🌿" }
local currentState: any = nil
local activeTab = "Inventory"
local messageLabel: TextLabel
local content: ScrollingFrame
local screen: ScreenGui

local function create(className: string, props: {[string]: any}, parent: Instance): Instance
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in pairs(props) do (instance :: any)[key] = value end
	instance.Parent = parent
	return instance
end

local function corner(instance: Instance, radius: number)
	create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, instance)
end

local function label(parent: Instance, text: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2, fontSize: number, color: Color3, bold: boolean?): TextLabel
	return create("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, Size = size, Position = position,
		Font = if bold then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = fontSize,
		TextColor3 = color, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextWrapped = true,
	}, parent) :: TextLabel
end

local function button(parent: Instance, text: string, callback: () -> (), width: UDim2?): TextButton
	local result = create("TextButton", {
		Size = width or UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 38), BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.button, Text = text,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = true,
	}, parent) :: TextButton
	corner(result, 9)
	result.Activated:Connect(callback)
	return result
end

local function send(action: string, payload: any?)
	actionEvent:FireServer(action, payload)
end

local function clearContent()
	for _, child in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
	end
end

local function row(parent: Instance, height: number): Frame
	local frame = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height), BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.card, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent) :: Frame
	corner(frame, 12)
	return frame
end

local function addTitle(text: string, subtitle: string?)
	local heading = label(content, text, UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 34), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4), 22, COLORS.text, true)
	heading.LayoutOrder = 0
	if subtitle then
		local sub = label(content, subtitle, UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 36), 13, COLORS.muted, false)
		sub.LayoutOrder = 1
	end
end

local function setMessage(text: string?)
	messageLabel.Text = text or "Gather from nearby resources using their prompts."
end

local function renderInventory()
	addTitle("Your supplies", "Gather nearby trees, rocks, bushes, palms, and springs.")
	for i, item in ipairs(inventoryNames) do
		local entry = row(content, 54)
		entry.LayoutOrder = i + 1
		label(entry, (itemIcons[item] or "•") .. "  " .. item, UDim2.new(0.62, -12, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0), 16, COLORS.text, true)
		label(entry, tostring(currentState.Inventory[item] or 0), UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 0, 0), 17, COLORS.accent, true).TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	end
	for _, item in ipairs({ "Berries", "Coconut", "Water" }) do
		local count = currentState.Inventory[item] or 0
		if count > 0 then
			local entry = row(content, 54)
			entry.LayoutOrder = #inventoryNames + (item == "Berries" and 1 or item == "Coconut" and 2 or 3)
			label(entry, "Use " .. item, UDim2.new(0.48, -12, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0), 15, COLORS.text, true)
			local action = item == "Berries" and "Eat" or item == "Water" and "Drink" or "UseCoconut"
			button(entry, "USE  ·  " .. count, function() send(action) end, UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 36)).Position = UDim2.new(1, -124, 0.5, -18)
		end
	end
end

local function renderRecipes(isBuilding: boolean)
	local definitions = if isBuilding then Config.Buildings else Config.Recipes
	addTitle(if isBuilding then "Build a base" else "Crafting", if isBuilding then "Shelter restores health. Your base appears where you are standing." else "Turn gathered materials into tools and useful gear.")
	local order = 1
	for id, definition in pairs(definitions) do
		local crafted = if isBuilding then currentState.Buildings[id] else currentState.Crafted[id]
		local costs = {}
		for item, amount in pairs(definition.Cost) do table.insert(costs, tostring(amount) .. " " .. item) end
		table.sort(costs)
		local entry = row(content, 78)
		entry.LayoutOrder = order + 2
		order += 1
		label(entry, id, UDim2.new(0.53, -12, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 10), 15, COLORS.text, true)
		label(entry, table.concat(costs, "  ·  "), UDim2.new(0.55, -12, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 38), 11, COLORS.muted, false)
		local action = if isBuilding then "Build" else "Craft"
		local control = button(entry, if crafted then "DONE" else string.upper(action), function() send(action, id) end, UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 38))
		control.Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0.5, -19)
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if crafted then COLORS.panel else COLORS.button
		control.Active = not crafted
	end
end

local function renderMissions()
	addTitle("Island missions", "Complete objectives and claim your shell rewards.")
	for i, mission in pairs(Config.Missions) do
		local gathered = currentState.Gathered[mission.Item] or 0
		local completed = currentState.Missions[i]
		local progress = math.min(gathered, mission.Goal)
		local entry = row(content, 78)
		entry.LayoutOrder = i == "FirstGather" and 3 or 4
		label(entry, i, UDim2.new(0.55, -12, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 9), 14, COLORS.text, true)
		label(entry, string.format("%s  %d / %d  ·  +%d shells", mission.Item, progress, mission.Goal, mission.Reward), UDim2.new(0.63, -12, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 39), 11, COLORS.muted, false)
		local control = button(entry, if completed then "CLAIMED" else "CLAIM", function() send("ClaimMission", i) end, UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 38))
		control.Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0.5, -19)
		control.Active = not completed and gathered >= mission.Goal
		if completed or gathered < mission.Goal then control.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.panel end
	end
end

local function renderShop()
	addTitle("Island trader", "Balance: " .. tostring(currentState.Shells) .. " shells. Trade spare wood for supplies.")
	local offers = {
		{ "SellWood", "Trade 3 Wood", "+10 shells" },
		{ "BuyBerries", "Buy berries", "12 shells · restores hunger" },

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “Survival Island” game with a browser prototype and Roblox Luau project, including multiplayer survival systems, persistence, installation guidance, and testing instructions.

## Requirements
- Include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements, persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Keep Roblox gameplay server-authoritative and provide complete source and setup/testing documentation.
- Work in stages and verify the project without clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implement both a browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Generate the Roblox island and resources in code; use a programmatic Roblox client UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive browser prototype with map, survival systems, interactions, and local saves.
- Added Roblox config, persistence, generated world, and server-side gameplay modules.
- Added the Roblox server bootstrap and client UI for inventory, crafting, building, missions, and shop.
- Removed the resource model `PivotTo` offset and added Fiber as a Bush bonus drop.

### Active
- Validate and polish Roblox server/client systems, including shop inventory capacity and persistent building/world behavior.
- Add detailed README installation, DataStore, map, and testing instructions.
- Run available checks and inspect a browser prototype screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Check Roblox scripts for syntax/runtime issues and fix remaining gameplay edge cases.
2. Complete Roblox Studio and browser documentation in `README.md`.
3. Run available checks and inspect/capture the browser prototype.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Browser prototype interface.
- `style.css`: Responsive browser styling.
- `game.js`: Browser prototype simulation and interactions.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.
- `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`: Roblox gameplay and progression definitions.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`: DataStore persistence and profile sanitization.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua`: Generated island, resources, prompts, and lighting.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-validated actions and survival systems.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Main.server.lua`: Creates remotes and initializes server services.
- `roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`: Roblox HUD and gameplay controls.
- `README.md`: Existing project README; installation and testing documentation remains to be added.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- No Roblox or browser verification has been run since adding the bootstrap and client UI.

input.prompt: Review Roblox Luau files under roblox/src for likely syntax/runtime errors, server-authority/security issues, and gameplay edge cases. Do not edit files. Report specific file + line and proposed fixes. Thoroughness very thorough.

content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e5267ff41ffeX1Ei1vuU9GHejA" state="completed">
## Findings

1. **High — A temporary DataStore load failure can overwrite a player’s saved profile with defaults.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua:47-52`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua#L47-L52 ), [`:60-68`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua#L60-L68 )  
   If `GetAsync` fails, `Load` warns but creates and stores a default profile. The autosave or player-leave save can then write that default over the existing data. **Fix:** distinguish “load failed” from “new player”; retry or keep the player out of gameplay, and do not save until a successful load has been confirmed.

2. **High — Saves can overwrite newer data with a stale snapshot.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua:60-68`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua#L60-L68 )  
   `Save` snapshots the profile, then `UpdateAsync` unconditionally returns that snapshot. Concurrent autosave/leave saves—or a delayed save from an old server session—can therefore replace a newer profile. **Fix:** add per-user session ownership/locking and a conflict-aware `UpdateAsync` policy (or another versioned persistence strategy); also coordinate saves for a player so an older in-flight save cannot finish last.

3. **High — Shop purchases can exceed the intended total inventory cap.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua:173-180`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L173-L180 )  
   `BuyBerries` and `BuyWater` cap only the individual item count, while gathering enforces `MaxInventory` across all items. A player with a nearly full pack can buy goods and exceed the total capacity; purchases at an item’s individual cap can also charge shells without granting anything. **Fix:** calculate total free slots before charging, grant only the amount that fits (or reject the purchase), and make the UI reflect that result.

4. **High — The spawn is outside the island’s sand shelf.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua:72-76,97-101`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua#L72-L76 )  
   The shelf’s rotated cylinder extends about 235 studs along Z from its center, but `BeachSpawn` is at Z=265. The spawn platform is consequently separated from the island edge by a gap, leaving players to jump across or fall into the surrounding non-collidable water. **Fix:** place the spawn within the shelf footprint (and verify it against the actual terrain), or extend the shelf to meet it.

5. **Medium — The proximity-prompt gather path bypasses the configured action cooldown.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua:199-213,214-216`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L199-L216 )  
   The remote-event route applies `lastAction`, but prompt triggers call `tryGather` directly. Thus the same gather operation has different rate limits depending on its entry point. The gather checks help constrain the target and distance, but do not make the cooldown consistent. **Fix:** route both paths through a shared server-side per-player action validator/rate limiter, and keep resource health/depletion checks in that shared path.

6. **Medium — Build validation permits placement in water or outside the island.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua:113-129`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L113-L129 )  
   The server accepts any position inside a square of ±`IslandRadius` on X and Z, much larger than the island’s actual footprint, then places the floor at a fixed Y of 7.5. Builds can therefore be charged and created in the ocean, outside the island, or at an inappropriate height on raised terrain. **Fix:** validate the location against the island footprint, raycast for a suitable ground surface, and place the model relative to that surface before charging materials.

7. **Medium — Roblox character health and saved survival health can diverge.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua:221-225,238-244`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L221-L225 )  
   The code applies profile health on character spawn and periodically overwrites `Humanoid.Health` from the profile, but does not update the profile when Roblox damage changes the humanoid’s health. Damage/death from other game systems can be ignored, healed by the next tick, or lost on respawn. **Fix:** define one authoritative health system: either synchronize server-side humanoid damage/death into the profile, or disable/replace the other damage paths and apply all health changes through the survival system. When a build restores profile health, also update the humanoid immediately.

8. **Low — The startup path for players already present skips character initialization.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua:218-229`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L218-L229 )  
   Players handled by the `GetPlayers()` loop receive a loaded profile and a delayed state update, but do not get the `CharacterAdded` handler or `IslandDataLoaded` attribute used in the `PlayerAdded` path. If initialization runs with players already connected, respawns will not perform the same health/state setup. **Fix:** factor player setup into one function and call it from both paths; after loading, also check whether the player is still connected.

9. **Low — Depleted resources retain an active prompt.**  
   [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua:50-56,121-134`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua#L50-L56 )  
   Depletion hides parts but leaves the `ProximityPrompt` enabled. The server rejects the gather, so this is not a resource-grant bypass, but players can still see and activate a prompt that does nothing. **Fix:** disable the prompt on depletion and re-enable it on respawn.

I found no definite syntax errors by inspection. I did not run a Luau parser or execute the Roblox experience.
</subagent>

input.prompt: Review roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua plus config for client/server contract, UI runtime problems, usability, and bugs. Do not edit. Report findings with specific locations and fixes. Thoroughness very thorough.

content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e5267ff38ffedIpjfWwzQiHLd9" state="completed">
## Findings

1. **Shop offer text overlaps the trade buttons on narrow screens — medium severity**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:152–155](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L152)  
   The offer description starts at 59% of the row and uses 32% of its width, while the button starts at `row width - 94` and is 82 px wide. On a phone-sized row, those regions overlap by roughly 66 px; even at the 720 px desktop layout they overlap by about 20 px. Prices and benefit text can be obscured by the TRADE button.  
   **Fix:** Reserve a non-overlapping column for the button: reduce the description width, move it left, or use a horizontal layout with flexible text space and a fixed-width button.

2. **The HUD occupies most of the screen and cannot be hidden — medium severity**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:170–180](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L170)  
   The opaque panel is centered at 82% of viewport height and has no close, minimize, or toggle control. It is likely to obstruct the island and normal gameplay continuously.  
   **Fix:** Make the panel collapsible or toggleable, and consider a compact HUD by default with the full inventory panel opened on demand.

3. **Fixed vertical offsets can leave little or no content space on short screens — medium severity**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:187–218](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L187)  
   Header, vitals, navigation, and footer use fixed pixel heights/offsets. The scrolling area height is `1, -274`; on a short viewport the main panel can be under 274 px tall, producing a zero or negative effective content height and clipping/overlap.  
   **Fix:** Use a minimum panel size with a responsive compact layout, or calculate the vertical regions from available height and let the content area shrink only to a usable minimum. Test short landscape and small-window viewports.

4. **Crafted items are not represented in the inventory UI, despite the server saying to check inventory — medium severity**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:83–100, 103–122](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L83) · [GameService.lua:101–110](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L101) · [Config.lua:20–24](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua#L20)  
   The inventory renders only the six resource counts; it never displays `currentState.Crafted`. Yet the server tells players “Check your inventory” after crafting. `StoneAxe` has a passive server effect, but `WoodSpear` and the configured `Campfire` are only marked crafted—there is no visible inventory item or follow-up use/place action.  
   **Fix:** Show crafted items and their status in Inventory, and provide the intended use/place actions. Otherwise, revise the recipes and success message so they do not imply that crafted gear is available to use.

5. **The building-tab description overpromises health restoration — low-to-medium severity**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:103–106](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L103) · [Config.lua:26–29](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua#L26) · [GameService.lua:149–151](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L149)  
   The description says “Shelter restores health” for the whole Build tab, but `BeachCamp` has `Health = 0`; only `LeanTo` restores health.  
   **Fix:** Describe restoration specifically as a LeanTo benefit, or adjust the configured building effect if BeachCamp is intended to restore health too.

6. **Shop purchases can exceed the configured total inventory capacity — medium severity, contract mismatch**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:220–226](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L220) · [Config.lua:8](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua#L8) · [GameService.lua:19–22, 173–180](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L19)  
   The HUD presents `PACK total / MaxInventory`, and gathering enforces a total-pack limit. Shop purchases instead cap only the purchased item’s individual count, so buying berries or water can push the total above 40. The displayed pack capacity then contradicts actual server behavior.  
   **Fix:** Check total free slots before completing a purchase, and either reject or limit the purchase when the pack is full. Keep that check server-side.

7. **Shop actions look available even when they cannot succeed — usability issue**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:142–155](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L142)  
   All offers always show an active TRADE button, regardless of wood, shells, or pack space. Players can repeatedly trigger server messages for unavailable transactions.  
   **Fix:** Render affordability/availability from current state and disable or relabel unavailable actions; retain server validation as the authority.

8. **State updates rebuild the entire content list — possible scroll/flicker issue**  
   [SurvivalIsland.client.lua:56–60, 159–168](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua#L56) · [GameService.lua:231–245](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua#L231)  
   Each state event destroys and recreates every content row. The server sends state every 12 seconds, so this also happens during passive vitals updates. This can cause needless UI churn and may disrupt the user’s scroll position, especially when changing tabs with different content heights.

## Findings

- **[High] Keyboard movement can stop working after focusing any button.** In `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:84`, the keydown handler ignores movement keys whenever `document.activeElement` is a button. Clicking a button—such as Zoom, Help, or a Survival kit action—usually leaves it focused, so WASD/arrows then do nothing until focus moves elsewhere. Reproduce by clicking **+** and pressing WASD.

- **[Medium] Resource depletion is not saved.** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:9` initializes the resource amounts in memory, while `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:14` saves only `state`. Reloading preserves inventory and vitals but restores every depleted resource, allowing repeat gathering. This conflicts with the automatic-save messaging in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:31,44`.

- **[Medium] The displayed inventory capacity is not enforced and does not match the visible inventory.** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:70` displays a total “/ 40” but never blocks gathering, crafting, or building at 40. The total includes crafted gear and structures, while the inventory renders only six resource types; created items are not shown. Related UI is in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:37`.

- **[Medium] The game has no survival failure state.** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:71` reduces health when hunger or thirst is low, but clamps it to a minimum of 5. There is no death, game-over, or other consequence, so the survival loop cannot be lost.

- **[Low] The sound control is a placeholder rather than a toggle.** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:20` presents a sound button, but `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:85` only displays “The island is quiet for now.” The advertised control has no sound state or effect.

- **[Low] Large time jumps can leave the clock invalid.** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:71` subtracts 1,440 minutes and advances the day only once, even if a throttled or suspended tab accumulates multiple days. The display at line 70 can consequently show an hour greater than 23.

The core UI and interaction loop are present: canvas map, gathering, movement, vitals, crafting/building, missions, shop, save/reset controls, and responsive layouts. content.text:
<subagent sessionID="ses_e52659edeffeigTsfH7p7WvZIW" state="completed">
- **Persistence load failure and stale saves —** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua )
  - **Load failure can erase saved data:** `Load` warns on a failed `GetAsync`, then installs a default profile. `Save` can later write that profile over the existing record. Track whether loading succeeded, retry or prevent saving an uninitialized profile, and surface the failure to the player.
  - **Older snapshots can overwrite newer progress:** `Save` snapshots the profile before yielding to `UpdateAsync`, and its callback always returns that snapshot. Concurrent autosaves, leave saves, or shutdown saves can therefore persist stale data. Serialize saves per player or use versioned/dirty-state handling that prevents an older snapshot from replacing newer progress.
  - **Loaded inventory can exceed the pack limit:** `sanitize` clamps each item separately to `MaxInventory`, not the combined inventory total. Normalize or validate the total against the shared capacity rule.

- **Shop inventory capacity —** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua )
  - `BuyBerries` and `BuyWater` cap only the purchased item’s stack, but capacity is the sum of all inventory items. A purchase can exceed total capacity; it also deducts shells even if the item is already at its per-item cap. Check free total slots first, limit the amount purchased to available slots, and charge only for items actually granted.

- **Prompt cooldowns —** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua), [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua )
  - The remote-action cooldown applies to `Action` events, but `ProximityPrompt.Triggered` calls `tryGather` directly and bypasses it. Apply a server-side per-player gather cooldown in the shared gather path so prompt and remote gathering receive the same rate limit. Consider per-resource limits if repeated gathering of one resource is the concern.

- **Build placement and restoration —** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua)
  - Placement checks only whether the player’s X and Z coordinates are within a square bound. It does not check ground height, water, or overlap; the floor is placed at a fixed Y, so it can float, sink, or land off-island. Raycast to valid ground and reject water/out-of-bounds or obstructed locations before charging materials.
  - The saved `Buildings` flag prevents rebuilding, but the constructed model exists only in `Workspace` and is not recreated when a saved profile loads. Persist placement data and reconstruct builds, or do not persist the flag until builds can be restored.

- **Spawn position —** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua)
  - `BeachSpawn` is placed at `(0, 1, 265)`, beyond the generated island/resource Z extent (resource placement is limited to about ±216). Verify the spawn against the actual island geometry and move it onto a confirmed land location; otherwise players may spawn off the island or on an unsupported platform.

- **UI visibility and responsiveness —** [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`]( /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua)
  - The GUI starts enabled, and there is no close/hide control; its large centered panel remains over gameplay. Add a hide/open toggle or reduce it to a compact HUD.
  - The five navigation buttons are forced into one row, while shop/build rows use fixed-width controls alongside percentage-width text. On narrow screens those elements can become cramped or overlap. Add a narrow-screen stacked/scrollable layout and size controls from available space.
  - On wide screens the panel is fixed at `720×560` rather than constrained by viewport height. Use viewport-aware maximum dimensions so short screens do not clip the panel or its content.
</subagent>

<subagent sessionID="ses_e52659edaffe4ZMWJVWENHqNdL" state="completed">
## Findings

- **Keyboard movement and focus — `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:84`, `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:25,29`**  
  Movement is handled by document-level key listeners, but keydown returns when a `<button>` is focused. That makes WASD/arrows ineffective while focus is on a game control, and there is no canvas focus target or explicit focus instruction. Consider giving the canvas `tabindex="0"` and making movement work when the game canvas is focused, while continuing to ignore keys in interactive controls. Also clear the `moving` set on window blur/visibility change so a held key cannot leave movement stuck. The mobile-pad pointer handlers at `game.js:86` should also account for pointer capture or window-level release so dragging off a button does not strand a direction.

- **Resource depletion persistence — `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:9,14,19-26`**  
  Resource amounts live only in the in-memory `resources` array. `save()` serializes `state`, not those amounts, so gathering, saving, then reloading restores depleted resources to their initial amounts while retaining the gathered inventory. Persist resource depletion (or resource state) alongside the player state and restore it during initialization.

- **Capacity is display-only — `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:16-18,25,70,77-81`**  
  The UI displays `total / 40`, but `addItem()` and the gather/craft/build/shop paths do not enforce a 40-item limit. Gathering and crafting can push the total over capacity. Enforce capacity at the shared item-add/payment points and provide feedback when an action would exceed it; consider how crafted tools/buildings count toward the same limit.

- **No survival failure state — `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:5,71`**  
  `health` is clamped to a minimum of 5 when hunger/thirst are low, and there is no game-over or disabled-play state. If death/failure is intended, allow health to reach zero and implement a failure UI plus rules for movement/actions, save/reset, and restart. Otherwise, make the non-lethal health floor an intentional, communicated mechanic.

- **Sound control is a placeholder — `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:85`; `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:20`**  
  The “Toggle sound” button only shows a toast; it has no sound state or audio behavior. Implement an actual toggle and indicate its state accessibly, or rename/remove the control until sound exists.

- **Clock rollover — `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:71`**  
  The clock subtracts one day when `minute >= 1440`. A sufficiently delayed tick can add multiple days’ worth of minutes and leave the clock past 24:00. Normalize with a loop or modulo and increment `day` by the number of elapsed days. Note that `lastTick` is initialized to the current time, so elapsed offline time is not simulated; clarify whether that is intentional.

## README and test commands

- **`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md:1-18`** contains generated-project links but no game-specific overview, controls, local run instructions, mechanics, save/reset behavior, or test guidance. Add those details.
- No root `package.json`, test/spec files, or common test-runner configuration was found. There is no project-level test command apparent. `index.html` references `game.js` and `style.css` directly, so the prototype can be tried by serving the root as static files; `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh:1-4` is a runtime-specific wrapper, not a documented test command.
</subagent>

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete “Survival Island” as a playable browser prototype and Roblox Luau project, including survival, progression, persistence, multiplayer support, and setup/testing guidance.

## Requirements
- Include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements, persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Keep Roblox gameplay server-authoritative; provide source, installation guidance, DataStore notes, and testing instructions.
- Work in stages and verify the project without clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implement both a browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Generate the Roblox island and resources in code, with a programmatic Roblox client UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive browser prototype and Roblox project structure, including gameplay systems, world generation, persistence, remotes, and client UI.
- Reviewed Roblox and browser code; identified concrete persistence, capacity, cooldown, placement, spawn, input, and UI issues.

### Active
- Fix Roblox data-load/save safety, shop capacity, prompt cooldowns, build placement/restoration, spawn location, and UI responsiveness.
- Fix browser resource persistence, inventory capacity, keyboard/pointer movement, survival failure state, sound control, and clock rollover.
- Expand `README.md` with gameplay, installation, DataStore, and testing guidance; run available checks and inspect the browser prototype.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Address high-priority Roblox persistence, shop-capacity, cooldown, build-placement, and spawn issues.
2. Polish Roblox UI visibility and narrow-screen layout.
3. Fix browser persistence, capacity, movement, failure-state, sound, and clock issues.
4. Complete project documentation and run available checks/browser inspection.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Browser prototype simulation, persistence, input, and interactions.
- `index.html`: Browser interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive browser styling.
- `README.md`: Project documentation; game setup and testing guidance remains to be added.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`: DataStore loading, sanitization, and saving.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-validated actions, inventory, building, and survival systems.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua`: Generated island, resources, prompts, and spawn.
- `roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`: Roblox HUD and gameplay controls.
- `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`: Roblox gameplay and progression definitions.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked in git.
- Roblox review found failed loads can later overwrite saved data; saves need serialization, and failed-load profiles must not be saved.
- Roblox shop purchases must respect combined inventory capacity; prompt gathering bypasses the remote cooldown.
- Roblox builds need valid ground/overlap checks and persisted construction restoration; `BeachSpawn` at `(0, 1, 265)` may be outside the island.
- Browser resource depletion is not saved; capacity is display-only; survival health never falls below 5; sound is a placeholder; clock rollover handles only one day.
- No Roblox or browser runtime verification has been performed; no project-level test runner was found.

--!strict
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStoreName)
local profiles: {[Player]: any} = {}
local saving: {[Player]: boolean} = {}

local function clone(value: any): any
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local result = {}
	for key, child in pairs(value) do result[key] = clone(child) end
	return result
end

local function sanitize(raw: any): any
	local profile = clone(Config.DefaultProfile)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then return profile end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Health", "Hunger", "Thirst" }) do
		if type(raw[key]) == "number" and raw[key] == raw[key] then profile[key] = math.clamp(raw[key], 0, 100) end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Shells", "XP", "Level" }) do
		if type(raw[key]) == "number" and raw[key] == raw[key] then profile[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(raw[key]), 0, 1000000) end
	end
	if type(raw.Inventory) == "table" then
		for item in pairs(profile.Inventory) do
			local amount = raw.Inventory[item]
			if type(amount) == "number" and amount == amount then profile.Inventory[item] = math.clamp(math.floor(amount), 0, Config.MaxInventory) end
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "Crafted", "Missions" }) do
		if type(raw[key]) == "table" then
			for id, value in pairs(raw[key]) do
				if type(id) == "string" and #id <= 40 and type(value) == "boolean" then profile[key][id] = value end
			end
		end
	end
	if type(raw.Buildings) == "table" then
		for id, value in pairs(raw.Buildings) do
			if type(id) == "string" and Config.Buildings[id] then
				if value == true then
					-- Migrate early prototype saves by restoring legacy bases at the island center.
					profile.Buildings[id] = { X = 0, Z = 0 }
				elseif type(value) == "table" and type(value.X) == "number" and type(value.Z) == "number" then
					profile.Buildings[id] = { X = math.clamp(value.X, -Config.IslandRadius, Config.IslandRadius), Z = math.clamp(value.Z, -Config.IslandRadius, Config.IslandRadius) }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if type(raw.Gathered) == "table" then
		for item in pairs(profile.Gathered) do
			local amount = raw.Gathered[item]
			if type(amount) == "number" and amount == amount then profile.Gathered[item] = math.clamp(math.floor(amount), 0, 1000000) end
		end
	end
	return profile
end

function DataService.Load(player: Player): any?
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if not success then
		warn("[SurvivalIsland] Data load failed for", player.UserId, result)
		return nil
	end
	if player.Parent ~= Players then return nil end
	local profile = sanitize(result)
	profiles[player] = profile
	return profile
end

function DataService.Get(player: Player): any?
	return profiles[player]
end

function DataService.Save(player: Player): boolean
	while saving[player] do task.wait() end
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile then return false end
	saving[player] = true
	local snapshot = clone(profile)
	local success, message = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, function()
			return snapshot
		end)
	end)
	saving[player] = nil
	if not success then warn("[SurvivalIsland] Data save failed for", player.UserId, message) end
	return success
end

function DataService.Remove(player: Player)
	profiles[player] = nil
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	DataService.Save(player)
	DataService.Remove(player)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	local pending = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		pending += 1
		task.spawn(function()
			DataService.Save(player)
			pending -= 1
		end)
	end
	while pending > 0 do task.wait() end
end)

return DataService

## Findings

1. **Failed data loads are treated as successful joins**  
   **Files/functions:**  
   - `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua` — `DataService.Load` (lines 60–71) returns `nil` when `GetAsync` fails.  
   - `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua` — `Players.PlayerAdded` handler (lines 218–227).

   **Issue:** The join handler sets `IslandDataLoaded = true` regardless of whether `Data.Load` returned a profile. Its `CharacterAdded` handler then accesses `profile.Health`; after a failed load, `profile` is nil and that access errors. Gameplay actions also have no profile to operate on, while the client can remain on its loading UI because `sendState` has no state to send.

   **Recommended fix:** Treat a nil load as an explicit failure: do not mark the player loaded or install profile-dependent behavior until a profile exists. Retry transient DataStore failures, then either safely keep the player out of gameplay or disconnect with a clear message. Guard character setup against a missing profile, and only set the loaded attribute and send initial state after successful loading. Apply the same success handling to the existing-player load loop at line 229.

2. **Shop purchases check per-item caps, not combined inventory capacity**  
   **File/function:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua` — `shop` (lines 165–181); `inventoryUsed` (lines 19–23); capacity setting in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua` (line 8).

   **Issue:** `BuyBerries` and `BuyWater` cap only the purchased item’s count at `Config.MaxInventory`. They can therefore push the sum of all inventory items above the shared pack limit. The current code also deducts shells even when the item is already at its per-item cap.

   **Recommended fix:** Before charging, calculate free combined slots using `inventoryUsed(profile)`. Reject the transaction if the offer cannot fit, or explicitly support a partial purchase and charge only for the amount granted. Never deduct shells for an unfulfilled purchase.

3. **ProximityPrompt gathering bypasses the shared action cooldown**  
   **File/function:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua` — action remote handler in `GameService.Initialize` (lines 199–213), and prompt connection (lines 214–216).

   **Issue:** Remote actions pass through `lastAction`/`Config.ActionCooldown`, but each prompt calls `tryGather` directly. A player can therefore gather through prompts without the cooldown applied to other actions.

   **Recommended fix:** Put cooldown enforcement in a shared server-side action/gather entry point and route both the remote action and prompt-triggered gather through it. Keep the existing server-side target, range, and resource checks in `tryGather`.

4. **Build placement and saved-building restoration are incomplete and insufficiently validated**  
   **Files/functions:**  
   - `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua` — `build` (lines 113–152); player load handling in `GameService.Initialize` (lines 218–229).  
   - `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua` — `sanitize` building handling (lines 39–50).  
   - `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua` is **not** the path; the relevant config is `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`, with `IslandRadius` at line 9.

   **Issue:** `build` accepts any position inside a square X/Z bound, without checking that the footprint is on valid island ground, at a valid height, or clear of other objects. It places the floor at a fixed Y and records `profile.Buildings[buildingId] = true`, not the placement coordinates. Although `sanitize` understands `{X, Z}` records (and migrates `true` to the center), the load path never recreates saved buildings. In addition, the sanitizer clamps coordinates to the configured radius rather than validating a valid placement; that radius is broader than parts of the generated island footprint.

   **Recommended fix:** Validate the full building footprint against the actual island surface and placement rules before charging or recording the build. Determine placement height from a server-side ground check rather than a fixed Y. Persist validated coordinates, and add a single server-side building-construction routine used both for new builds and restoration after successful data load. Validate saved coordinates as finite and placeable; discard invalid entries rather than merely clamping them. Handle the legacy `true` migration deliberately so it results in an actual restored building.

5. **The configured spawn appears outside the generated island**  
   **File/function:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/WorldService.lua` — spawn creation in `WorldService.Initialize` (lines 97–101).

   **Issue:** `BeachSpawn` is placed at `(0, 1, 265)`. The generated island shelf’s Z extent is about 235 studs, and generated resource positions reach only about 202 studs in Z, so this spawn is beyond the constructed island surface and may leave characters unsupported over the ocean.

   **Recommended fix:** Move the spawn to a location verified to be on the generated island, and set its height to sit on the actual surface there. Verify the resulting spawn position against the island geometry rather than relying on the `IslandRadius` check used by building placement.
</subagent>

input.prompt: Inspect browser prototype files for checkpoint issues: resource persistence, inventory capacity enforcement, keyboard/pointer movement, survival failure state, sound control, clock rollover, README docs. Report findings and test/setup available. Do not edit.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e5263b231ffehpQr37VgwV2oP6" state="completed">
## Browser prototype checkpoint findings

| Area | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Resource persistence** | **Gathered resources do not persist across reloads.** The save data contains `state`, but resource amounts live in a separate in-memory array and aren’t included in saves. A depleted resource returns to its initial amount after reload, even though inventory remains saved. | `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:6,8-10,14,19-26` |
| **Inventory capacity** | **The displayed `0 / 40` capacity is not enforced.** `addItem` adds items without checking capacity, and gathering, crafting, and building can all increase inventory. The displayed total counts all `state.items`, including crafted/build items that aren’t shown in the six resource slots. | `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:16-18,25,70,77-78` |
| **Keyboard/pointer movement** | Keyboard movement and the mobile directional pad are implemented. Clicking the map does **not** move the player: canvas clicks only attempt to gather a nearby resource or show a toast. Keyboard movement also isn’t gated while a modal is open, so it can continue behind dialogs. Movement updates per animation frame rather than elapsed time, making speed dependent on frame rate. | `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:71,83-86`; controls are described in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:29,44` |
| **Survival failure state** | **There is no death/game-over state.** Health loss is clamped at 5, so it cannot reach zero; hunger and thirst can reach zero, but the code does not transition to a failure state. | `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:71` |
| **Sound control** | The sound button is labeled “Toggle sound,” but clicking it only displays “The island is quiet for now.” There is no sound playback or on/off state. | `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html:20`; `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:85` |
| **Clock rollover** | Normal rollover handles one day, but it subtracts 1440 minutes and increments the day only once. If a long pause/resume produces multiple days’ worth of elapsed ticks, the clock can remain beyond 23:59 and the day count will lag. | `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js:7,71` |
| **README/setup docs** | The README contains generic OMGithub links, not instructions for running the browser prototype or testing it. | `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md:1-18` |

## Test/setup available

- I found **no test/spec files** and **no `package.json`** in the project.
- The browser prototype is a static `index.html` loading `style.css` and `game.js`; there’s no build step or browser-test setup in the repository.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh` and `capture.sh` delegate to scripts under `${RUNTIME_DIR}`. They therefore require that environment variable and its external runtime scripts; they do not document or provide a standalone local test workflow. `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/startup.sh` contains only strict-shell setup.
- Findings above are from static inspection; I did not run the prototype or execute tests.
</subagent>
