local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local WorldService = {}
local resourceFolder: Folder
local buildingFolder: Folder
local groundFolder: Folder

local BUILDING_SIZE = Vector2.new(12, 10)
local ISLAND_HALF_WIDTH = 330
local ISLAND_HALF_DEPTH = 235

local function part(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material, shape: Enum.PartType?): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name, p.Size, p.Position, p.Color, p.Material = name, size, position, color, material
	p.Anchored, p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = true, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if shape then p.Shape = shape end
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function makeResource(kind: string, position: Vector3, index: number)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = kind .. string.format("_%02d", index)
	model:SetAttribute("ResourceType", kind)
	model:SetAttribute("Health", Config.Resources[kind].Health)
	model:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", Config.Resources[kind].Health)
	model:SetAttribute("ResourceIndex", index)
	local root: Part
	if kind == "Tree" or kind == "Palm" then
		root = part(model, "Trunk", Vector3.new(2.4, 17, 2.4), position + Vector3.new(0, 8.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(112, 82, 52), Enum.Material.Wood)
		root.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		if kind == "Palm" then
			local crown = part(model, "PalmCrown", Vector3.new(13, 3, 13), position + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0), Color3.fromRGB(68, 139, 75), Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
			crown.CanCollide = false
		else
			local crown = part(model, "Canopy", Vector3.new(13, 12, 13), position + Vector3.new(0, 17, 0), Color3.fromRGB(55, 119, 62), Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
			crown.CanCollide = false
		end
	elseif kind == "Rock" then
		root = part(model, "Rock", Vector3.new(8, 6, 7), position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(123, 132, 117), Enum.Material.Rock, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	elseif kind == "Bush" then
		root = part(model, "BerryBush", Vector3.new(7, 5, 7), position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(68, 140, 70), Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		local berries = part(model, "Berries", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), position + Vector3.new(1, 4, -2), Color3.fromRGB(177, 82, 128), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		berries.CanCollide = false
	else
		root = part(model, "Spring", Vector3.new(9, 0.6, 9), position + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(89, 190, 188), Enum.Material.Glass, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
		root.Transparency = 0.2
	end
	root.Name = "ResourceRoot"
	root:SetAttribute("IsResourceRoot", true)
	root.CanCollide = kind == "Rock"
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Gather"
	prompt.ObjectText = kind
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.25
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 16
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = root
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	-- Parts are created directly at their final world positions; PivotTo would offset the whole model.
	model.Parent = resourceFolder
	CollectionService:AddTag(model, "SurvivalResource")
end

local function islandPosition(rng: Random): Vector3
	local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
	local radius = math.sqrt(rng:NextNumber(0.06, 0.88)) * 300
	return Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 7, math.sin(angle) * radius * 0.72)
end

local function groundAt(x: number, z: number, character: Model?): RaycastResult?
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local excluded: {Instance} = { resourceFolder, buildingFolder }
	if character then table.insert(excluded, character) end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	params.IgnoreWater = false
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 200, z), Vector3.new(0, -280, 0), params)
	if not hit or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water then return nil end
	local instance = hit.Instance
	if instance == Workspace.Terrain or instance.Name == "IslandSandShelf" or instance.Name == "IslandHeart" or instance.Name == "BeachSpawn" then return hit end
	return nil
end

local function insideIsland(x: number, z: number): boolean
	local nx, nz = x / (ISLAND_HALF_WIDTH - 8), z / (ISLAND_HALF_DEPTH - 8)
	return nx * nx + nz * nz <= 1
end

function WorldService.GetIslandGroundHeight(x: number, z: number, character: Model?): number?
	local hit = groundAt(x, z, character)
	return if hit then hit.Position.Y else nil
end

function WorldService.CanPlaceBuilding(position: Vector3, character: Model?): (boolean, number?)
	local halfX, halfZ = BUILDING_SIZE.X / 2, BUILDING_SIZE.Y / 2
	local samples = {
		Vector2.new(0, 0), Vector2.new(-halfX, -halfZ), Vector2.new(-halfX, halfZ),
		Vector2.new(halfX, -halfZ), Vector2.new(halfX, halfZ), Vector2.new(0, -halfZ),
		Vector2.new(0, halfZ), Vector2.new(-halfX, 0), Vector2.new(halfX, 0),
	}
	local groundHeight: number? = nil
	local minHeight, maxHeight = math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, offset in ipairs(samples) do
		local x, z = position.X + offset.X, position.Z + offset.Y
		if not insideIsland(x, z) then return false, nil end
		local hit = groundAt(x, z, character)
		if not hit then return false, nil end
		groundHeight = groundHeight or hit.Position.Y
		minHeight = math.min(minHeight, hit.Position.Y)
		maxHeight = math.max(maxHeight, hit.Position.Y)
	end
	if maxHeight - minHeight > 5 then return false, nil end

	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local excluded: {Instance} = { groundFolder }
	if character then table.insert(excluded, character) end
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	local centerY = (groundHeight :: number) + 6
	local overlaps = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position.X, centerY, position.Z), Vector3.new(BUILDING_SIZE.X, 12, BUILDING_SIZE.Y), overlapParams)
	if #overlaps > 0 then return false, nil end
	return true, groundHeight
end

function WorldService.CreateBuilding(buildingId: string, ownerName: string, x: number, z: number, groundHeight: number): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = ownerName .. "_" .. buildingId
	model:SetAttribute("BuildingId", buildingId)
	local floor = Instance.new("Part")
	floor.Name, floor.Anchored, floor.Size = "Floor", true, Vector3.new(BUILDING_SIZE.X, 0.6, BUILDING_SIZE.Y)
	floor.Material, floor.Color = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, Color3.fromRGB(142, 111, 73)
	floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, groundHeight + 0.3, z)
	floor.Parent = model
	if buildingId == "LeanTo" then
		for _, offset in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local beam = Instance.new("WedgePart")
			beam.Name, beam.Anchored, beam.Size = "PalmRoof", true, Vector3.new(7, 9, 12)
			beam.Material, beam.Color = Enum.Material.Wood, Color3.fromRGB(112, 137, 77)
			beam.CFrame = floor.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset * 2.8, 4.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(offset * 24))
			beam.Parent = model
		end
	else
		local fire = Instance.new("Part")
		fire.Name, fire.Shape, fire.Size = "Campfire", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 2.5)
		fire.Anchored, fire.Material, fire.Color = true, Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(255, 143, 59)
		fire.Position = Vector3.new(x, groundHeight + 2, z)
		fire.Parent = model
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = Color3.fromRGB(255, 159, 83), 18, 1.5
		light.Parent = fire
	end
	model.Parent = buildingFolder
	return model
end

function WorldService.Initialize()
	groundFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	groundFolder.Name = "IslandGround"
	groundFolder.Parent = Workspace
	local terrain = Workspace.Terrain
	terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(0, -18, 0), Vector3.new(2048, 32, 2048), Enum.Material.Water)
	local sandBase = part(groundFolder, "IslandSandShelf", Vector3.new(18, 660, 470), Vector3.new(0, -7, 0), Color3.fromRGB(224, 204, 148), Enum.Material.Sand, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	sandBase.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -7, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	sandBase.CanCollide = true
	local grassBase = part(groundFolder, "IslandHeart", Vector3.new(14, 610, 420), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(92, 130, 73), Enum.Material.Grass, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
	grassBase.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	grassBase.CanCollide = true
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(35, 28, -55), 86, Enum.Material.Ground)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(35, 49, -55), 65, Enum.Material.Rock)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(-105, 23, 20), 56, Enum.Material.Ground)
	terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(-105, 40, 20), 39, Enum.Material.Rock)
	terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(8, 2, 148), Vector3.new(16, 5, 130), Enum.Material.Water)
	resourceFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	resourceFolder.Name = "IslandResources"
	resourceFolder.Parent = Workspace
	buildingFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	buildingFolder.Name = "IslandBuildings"
	buildingFolder.Parent = Workspace
	local rng = Random.new(72024)
	local kinds = { Tree = 70, Palm = 24, Rock = 24, Bush = 28, Spring = 5 }
	local index = 0
	for kind, amount in pairs(kinds) do
		for _ = 1, amount do
			index += 1
			local pos = islandPosition(rng)
			if kind == "Spring" then pos += Vector3.new(0, 0, -20) end
			makeResource(kind, pos, index)
		end
	end
	local spawnPosition = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local spawnGround = WorldService.GetIslandGroundHeight(spawnPosition.X, spawnPosition.Z, nil) or 7
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name, spawn.Size, spawn.Position = "BeachSpawn", Vector3.new(18, 1, 18), Vector3.new(spawnPosition.X, spawnGround + 0.5, spawnPosition.Z)
	spawn.Anchored, spawn.Neutral, spawn.Material = true, true, Enum.Material.Sand
	spawn.Color = Color3.fromRGB(224, 204, 148)
	spawn.Parent = groundFolder
	Lighting.ClockTime = 8
	Lighting.Brightness = 2
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(116, 135, 125)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(153, 170, 156)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.35
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.45
	local atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
	atmosphere.Density, atmosphere.Offset = 0.25, 0.12
	atmosphere.Color, atmosphere.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(197, 230, 219), Color3.fromRGB(95, 151, 156)
	atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
	local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
	bloom.Intensity, bloom.Size, bloom.Threshold = 0.18, 24, 1.2
	bloom.Parent = Lighting
end

function WorldService.GetResourceFolder(): Folder
	return resourceFolder
end

function WorldService.RespawnResource(model: Model)
	if not model.Parent then return end
	local kind = model:GetAttribute("ResourceType")
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or not Config.Resources[kind] then return end
	model:SetAttribute("Health", Config.Resources[kind].Health)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then descendant.Transparency = 0; descendant.CanQuery = true end
	end
end

function WorldService.SetResourceDepleted(model: Model)
	for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then descendant.Transparency = 0.72; descendant.CanQuery = false end
	end
end

return WorldService
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SurvivalIslandRemotes")
local actionEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("Action") :: RemoteEvent
local stateEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("State") :: RemoteEvent
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

local COLORS = {
	background = Color3.fromRGB(13, 30, 34), panel = Color3.fromRGB(23, 48, 49), card = Color3.fromRGB(31, 62, 60),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 218), muted = Color3.fromRGB(166, 188, 167), accent = Color3.fromRGB(211, 226, 151),
	button = Color3.fromRGB(101, 138, 82), danger = Color3.fromRGB(188, 113, 86),
}
local inventoryNames = { "Wood", "Stone", "Berries", "Coconut", "Water", "Fiber" }
local itemIcons = { Wood = "🪵", Stone = "🪨", Berries = "🫐", Coconut = "🥥", Water = "💧", Fiber = "🌿" }
local currentState: any = nil
local activeTab = "Inventory"
local messageLabel: TextLabel
local content: ScrollingFrame
local screen: ScreenGui
local navButtons: {TextButton} = {}

local function create(className: string, props: {[string]: any}, parent: Instance): Instance
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in pairs(props) do (instance :: any)[key] = value end
	instance.Parent = parent
	return instance
end

local function corner(instance: Instance, radius: number)
	create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, instance)
end

local function label(parent: Instance, text: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2, fontSize: number, color: Color3, bold: boolean?): TextLabel
	return create("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, Size = size, Position = position,
		Font = if bold then Enum.Font.GothamBold else Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = fontSize,
		TextColor3 = color, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextWrapped = true,
	}, parent) :: TextLabel
end

local function button(parent: Instance, text: string, callback: () -> (), width: UDim2?): TextButton
	local result = create("TextButton", {
		Size = width or UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 38), BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.button, Text = text,
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13, AutoButtonColor = true,
	}, parent) :: TextButton
	corner(result, 9)
	result.Activated:Connect(callback)
	return result
end

local function send(action: string, payload: any?)
	if action ~= "RequestState" and not currentState then return end
	if player:GetAttribute("IslandDataLoaded") ~= true and action ~= "RequestState" then return end
	actionEvent:FireServer(action, payload)
end

local function clearContent()
	for _, child in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
	end
end

local function row(parent: Instance, height: number): Frame
	local frame = create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height), BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.card, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent) :: Frame
	corner(frame, 12)
	return frame
end

local function addTitle(text: string, subtitle: string?)
	local heading = label(content, text, UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 34), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4), 22, COLORS.text, true)
	heading.LayoutOrder = 0
	if subtitle then
		local sub = label(content, subtitle, UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 36), 13, COLORS.muted, false)
		sub.LayoutOrder = 1
	end
end

local function setMessage(text: string?)
	messageLabel.Text = text or "Gather from nearby resources using their prompts."
end

local function renderInventory()
	addTitle("Your supplies", "Gather nearby trees, rocks, bushes, palms, and springs.")
	for i, item in ipairs(inventoryNames) do
		local entry = row(content, 54)
		entry.LayoutOrder = i + 1
		label(entry, (itemIcons[item] or "•") .. "  " .. item, UDim2.new(0.62, -12, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0), 16, COLORS.text, true)
		label(entry, tostring(currentState.Inventory[item] or 0), UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 0, 0), 17, COLORS.accent, true).TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	end
	for _, item in ipairs({ "Berries", "Coconut", "Water" }) do
		local count = currentState.Inventory[item] or 0
		if count > 0 then
			local entry = row(content, 54)
			entry.LayoutOrder = #inventoryNames + (item == "Berries" and 1 or item == "Coconut" and 2 or 3)
			label(entry, "Use " .. item, UDim2.new(0.48, -12, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0), 15, COLORS.text, true)
			local action = item == "Berries" and "Eat" or item == "Water" and "Drink" or "UseCoconut"
			button(entry, "USE  ·  " .. count, function() send(action) end, UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 36)).Position = UDim2.new(1, -124, 0.5, -18)
		end
	end
end

local function renderRecipes(isBuilding: boolean)
	local definitions = if isBuilding then Config.Buildings else Config.Recipes
	addTitle(if isBuilding then "Build a base" else "Crafting", if isBuilding then "Shelter restores health. Your base appears where you are standing." else "Turn gathered materials into tools and useful gear.")
	local order = 1
	for id, definition in pairs(definitions) do
		local crafted = if isBuilding then currentState.Buildings[id] else currentState.Crafted[id]
		local costs = {}
		for item, amount in pairs(definition.Cost) do table.insert(costs, tostring(amount) .. " " .. item) end
		table.sort(costs)
		local entry = row(content, 78)
		entry.LayoutOrder = order + 2
		order += 1
		label(entry, id, UDim2.new(0.53, -12, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 10), 15, COLORS.text, true)
		label(entry, table.concat(costs, "  ·  "), UDim2.new(0.55, -12, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 38), 11, COLORS.muted, false)
		local action = if isBuilding then "Build" else "Craft"
		local control = button(entry, if crafted then "DONE" else string.upper(action), function() send(action, id) end, UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 38))
		control.Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0.5, -19)
		control.BackgroundColor3 = if crafted then COLORS.panel else COLORS.button
		control.Active = not crafted
	end
end

local function renderMissions()
	addTitle("Island missions", "Complete objectives and claim your shell rewards.")
	for i, mission in pairs(Config.Missions) do
		local gathered = currentState.Gathered[mission.Item] or 0
		local completed = currentState.Missions[i]
		local progress = math.min(gathered, mission.Goal)
		local entry = row(content, 78)
		entry.LayoutOrder = i == "FirstGather" and 3 or 4
		label(entry, i, UDim2.new(0.55, -12, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 9), 14, COLORS.text, true)
		label(entry, string.format("%s  %d / %d  ·  +%d shells", mission.Item, progress, mission.Goal, mission.Reward), UDim2.new(0.63, -12, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 39), 11, COLORS.muted, false)
		local control = button(entry, if completed then "CLAIMED" else "CLAIM", function() send("ClaimMission", i) end, UDim2.new(0, 96, 0, 38))
		control.Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0.5, -19)
		control.Active = not completed and gathered >= mission.Goal
		if completed or gathered < mission.Goal then control.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.panel end
	end
end

local function renderShop()
	addTitle("Island trader", "Balance: " .. tostring(currentState.Shells) .. " shells. Trade spare wood for supplies.")
	local offers = {
		{ "SellWood", "Trade 3 Wood", "+10 shells" },
		{ "BuyBerries", "Buy berries", "12 shells · restores hunger" },
		{ "BuyWater", "Buy fresh water", "15 shells · restores thirst" },
	}
	for i, offer in ipairs(offers) do
		local entry = row(content, 66)
		entry.LayoutOrder = i + 2
		label(entry, offer[2], UDim2.new(0.55, -12, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0), 14, COLORS.text, true)
		label(entry, offer[3], UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0.59, 0, 0, 0), 11, COLORS.muted, false)
		local control = button(entry, "TRADE", function() send("Shop", offer[1]) end, UDim2.new(0, 82, 0, 36))
		control.Position = UDim2.new(1, -94, 0.5, -18)
	end
end

local function render()
	if not currentState then return end
	clearContent()
	if activeTab == "Inventory" then renderInventory()
	elseif activeTab == "Craft" then renderRecipes(false)
	elseif activeTab == "Build" then renderRecipes(true)
	elseif activeTab == "Missions" then renderMissions()
	else renderShop() end
	setMessage(currentState.Message)
end

screen = create("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "SurvivalIslandHUD", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = false, DisplayOrder = 10,
}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")) :: ScreenGui
local main = create("Frame", {
	Name = "Main", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
	Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.82, 0), BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.background, BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, screen) :: Frame
local function resizeMain()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local width = math.min(viewport.X * 0.94, 720)
	local height = math.min(viewport.Y * (if viewport.Y < 460 then 0.96 else 0.88), 560)
	main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)

	local compact = viewport.Y < 460
	local header = main:FindFirstChild("Header") :: Frame?
	local vitals = main:FindFirstChild("Vitals") :: Frame?
	local nav = main:FindFirstChild("Nav") :: Frame?
	local content = main:FindFirstChild("Content") :: ScrollingFrame?
	local footer = main:FindFirstChild("Footer") :: Frame?
	local statusLabel = if header then header:FindFirstChild("Status") :: TextLabel? else nil
	if compact then
		if header then header.Position, header.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6), UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 54) end
		if statusLabel then statusLabel.Position, statusLabel.Size, statusLabel.TextSize = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 27), UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 25), 10 end
		if vitals then vitals.Position, vitals.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 64), UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 52) end
		if nav then nav.Position, nav.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 124), UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 36) end
		if content then content.Position, content.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 166), UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -212) end
		if footer then footer.Size, footer.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 32), UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -38) end
	else
		if header then header.Position, header.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 12), UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 76) end
		if statusLabel then statusLabel.Position, statusLabel.Size, statusLabel.TextSize = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 33), UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 38), 12 end
		if vitals then vitals.Position, vitals.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 90), UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 72) end
		if nav then nav.Position, nav.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 174), UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 42) end
		if content then content.Position, content.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 222), UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -274) end
		if footer then footer.Size, footer.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -46) end
	end
	for _, navButton in ipairs(navButtons) do
		navButton.TextSize = if viewport.X < 390 then 9 else 11
		navButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, -3, 0, if compact then 32 else 38)
	end
end
corner(main, 20)
create("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 111, 87), Transparency = 0.25, Thickness = 1 }, main)

local header = create("Frame", { Name = "Header", Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 76), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, main)
label(header, "✳  SURVIVAL ISLAND", UDim2.new(0.62, 0, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0), 19, COLORS.accent, true)
local status = label(header, "Loading survivor data…", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 38), UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 33), 12, COLORS.muted, false)
status.Name = "Status"

local vitals = create("Frame", { Name = "Vitals", Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 72), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 90), BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.panel, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, main)
corner(vitals, 12)
local vitalLabels = {}
for i, name in ipairs({ "Health", "Hunger", "Thirst" }) do
	local block = create("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -10, 1, -8), Position = UDim2.new((i-1)/3, 10, 0, 4) }, vitals)
	label(block, name, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 21), UDim2.new(), 11, COLORS.muted, true)
	local value = label(block, "100", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24), 17, COLORS.text, true)
	vitalLabels[name] = value
end

local nav = create("Frame", { Name = "Nav", Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 42), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 174), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, main)
local navLayout = create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, Padding = UDim.new(0, 3), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, nav)
navLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
navButtons = {}
for i, tab in ipairs({ "Inventory", "Craft", "Build", "Missions", "Shop" }) do
	local navButton = button(nav, tab, function() activeTab = tab; render() end, UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 38))
	navButton.LayoutOrder = i
	navButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, -3, 0, 38)
	navButton.TextSize = 11
	navButton.Active = false
	table.insert(navButtons, navButton)
end

content = create("ScrollingFrame", {
	Name = "Content", Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 222), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -274),
	BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 4, ScrollBarImageColor3 = COLORS.accent,
	CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
}, main) :: ScrollingFrame
create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, content)
local footer = create("Frame", { Name = "Footer", Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -46), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, main)
messageLabel = label(footer, "Gather from nearby resources using their prompts.", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(), 12, COLORS.accent, false)
resizeMain()
if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(resizeMain) end

local function updateLoadNotice()
	if currentState then return end
	local failed = player:GetAttribute("IslandDataLoadFailed") == true
	status.Text = if failed then "DATA LOAD FAILED · Rejoin to try again" else "Loading survivor data…"
	messageLabel.Text = if failed then "Your progress wasn't changed. Please rejoin once data services are available." else "Survivor controls unlock after your profile loads."
	for _, navButton in ipairs(navButtons) do navButton.Active = false end
end

local function updateHUD(state: any)
	currentState = state
	for _, navButton in ipairs(navButtons) do navButton.Active = true end
	status.Text = string.format("LEVEL %d   ·   %d SHELLS   ·   PACK %d / %d", state.Level, state.Shells, (function()
		local total = 0
		for _, count in pairs(state.Inventory) do total += count end
		return total
	end)(), Config.MaxInventory)
	vitalLabels.Health.Text = "♥  " .. math.floor(state.Health)
	vitalLabels.Hunger.Text = "◉  " .. math.floor(state.Hunger)
	vitalLabels.Thirst.Text = "≈  " .. math.floor(state.Thirst)
	render()
end
stateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(updateHUD)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IslandDataLoadFailed"):Connect(updateLoadNotice)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IslandDataLoaded"):Connect(function()
	if not currentState then updateLoadNotice() end
	if player:GetAttribute("IslandDataLoaded") == true then send("RequestState") end
end)
updateLoadNotice()
send("RequestState")

## Objective
- Complete “Survival Island” as a playable browser prototype and Roblox Luau project, including survival, progression, persistence, multiplayer support, and setup/testing guidance.

## Requirements
- Include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements, persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Keep Roblox gameplay server-authoritative; provide source, installation guidance, DataStore notes, and testing instructions.
- Work in stages and verify the project without clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implement both a browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Generate the Roblox island and resources in code, with a programmatic Roblox client UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Roblox project is organized under `roblox/`; browser UI and gameplay prototype are present.
- Roblox `GameService` includes periodic DataStore saves and server-side gathered mission progress.

### Active
- Fix `game.js`: it currently declares `const missions` twice, which causes a syntax error; add gathered-progress loading/persistence and make mission progress use gathered totals.
- Address browser inventory display/counting for crafted and built outputs, movement while panels are open, reset when storage is unavailable, and duplicate sound cues.
- Review Roblox save sanitization and persistence risks; clarify unused recipe effects.
- Expand `README.md` with gameplay, launch, Roblox/Rojo installation, DataStore setup, and testing guidance.
- Rerun available checks and inspect final project status.

### Blocked
- Roblox runtime verification is unavailable; Luau, Rojo, Selene, and Stylua commands were not found.

## Next Move
1. Remove the duplicate `missions` declaration and repair browser save loading, gathered tracking, and mission progress.
2. Fix browser inventory semantics/display, panel movement, reset handling, and sound feedback.
3. Harden or document Roblox profile sanitization and save risks; address recipe effects or align their descriptions.
4. Add README usage, setup, DataStore, and testing guidance.
5. Rerun available checks, review project status, and report uncommitted changes.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Browser simulation, save loading, inventory, input, missions, and sound.
- `README.md`: Contains only generated OMGithub links; project guidance remains to be added.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`: DataStore loading, sanitization, and saving.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-authoritative actions, inventory, buildings, survival, missions, and periodic saving.
- `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`: Roblox gameplay and progression definitions.
- `roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`: Roblox HUD and gameplay controls.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.
- `index.html`: Browser interface and controls.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked in git.
- Current `game.js` has duplicate top-level `const missions` declarations; `loadState()` runs between them, and the later declaration uses inventory counts instead of gathered totals.
- Browser gathering does not update `state.gathered`, and `loadState()` does not sanitize or restore it.
- Crafted and built outputs are added to `state.items` and counted toward capacity, but the browser inventory UI only displays six raw-material slots.
- Roblox inventory sanitization clamps each item independently without enforcing the aggregate `Config.MaxInventory`; `Crafted` and `Missions` also accept arbitrary string keys.
- Roblox runtime verification remains unavailable.

## Objective
- Complete “Survival Island” as a playable browser prototype and Roblox Luau project, including survival, progression, persistence, multiplayer support, and setup/testing guidance.

## Requirements
- Include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements, persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Keep Roblox gameplay server-authoritative; provide source, installation guidance, DataStore notes, and testing instructions.
- Work in stages and verify the project without clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implement both a browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Generate the Roblox island and resources in code, with a programmatic Roblox client UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Roblox project is organized under `roblox/`; browser UI and gameplay prototype are present.
- Roblox `GameService` includes periodic DataStore saves and server-side gathered mission progress.
- In `game.js`, removed the duplicate mission declaration and added loading/sanitization of saved `gathered` totals.

### Active
- Fix `game.js`: gathering must update `state.gathered`, and missions must use gathered totals.
- Address browser inventory display/counting for crafted and built outputs, movement while panels are open, reset when storage is unavailable, and duplicate sound cues.
- Review Roblox save sanitization and persistence risks; clarify unused recipe effects.
- Expand `README.md` with gameplay, launch, Roblox/Rojo installation, DataStore setup, and testing guidance.
- Rerun available checks and inspect final project status.

### Blocked
- Roblox runtime verification is unavailable; Luau, Rojo, Selene, and Stylua commands were not found.

## Next Move
1. Update browser gathered totals after gathering and ensure mission progress reads those totals.
2. Fix browser inventory display, panel movement, reset behavior, and duplicate sound feedback.
3. Harden or document Roblox profile sanitization and persistence risks; align unused recipe effects with their descriptions.
4. Add README usage, setup, DataStore, and testing guidance.
5. Run available checks, review project status, and report uncommitted changes.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Browser simulation, save loading, inventory, input, missions, and sound.
- `README.md`: Still contains only generated OMGithub links; project guidance remains to be added.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`: DataStore loading, sanitization, and saving.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-authoritative actions, inventory, buildings, survival, missions, and periodic saving.
- `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`: Roblox gameplay and progression definitions.
- `roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`: Roblox HUD and gameplay controls.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.
- `index.html`: Browser interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Browser layout and responsive styles.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked in git.
- The duplicate `const missions` declaration was removed; the remaining mission definitions use gathered totals, but browser gathering still does not update `state.gathered`.
- Saved `gathered` values are now restored and sanitized in `loadState()`.
- Browser crafted and built outputs are added to `state.items` and count toward capacity, but the inventory UI only displays six raw-material slots.
- Roblox inventory sanitization still needs an aggregate `Config.MaxInventory` limit; `Crafted` and `Missions` currently accept arbitrary string keys.
- Roblox runtime verification remains unavailable.

21: local function sanitize(raw: any): any

24: 	for _, key in ipairs({ "Health", "Hunger", "Thirst" }) do
25: 		if isFiniteNumber(raw[key]) then profile[key] = math.clamp(raw[key], 0, 100) end
26: 	end
27: 	for _, key in ipairs({ "Shells", "XP", "Level" }) do
28: 		if isFiniteNumber(raw[key]) then profile[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(raw[key]), 0, 1000000) end
29: 	end
30: 	if type(raw.Inventory) == "table" then
31: 		for item in pairs(profile.Inventory) do
32: 			local amount = raw.Inventory[item]
33: 			if isFiniteNumber(amount) then profile.Inventory[item] = math.clamp(math.floor(amount), 0, Config.MaxInventory) end
34: 		end
35: 	end
36: 	for _, key in ipairs({ "Crafted", "Missions" }) do
37: 		if type(raw[key]) == "table" then
38: 			for id, value in pairs(raw[key]) do
39: 				if type(id) == "string" and #id <= 40 and type(value) == "boolean" then profile[key][id] = value end
40: 			end
41: 		end
42: 	end
43: 	if type(raw.Buildings) == "table" then
44: 		for id, value in pairs(raw.Buildings) do
45: 			if type(id) == "string" and Config.Buildings[id] then
46: 				if value == true then

53: 					}

## Objective
- Complete “Survival Island” as a playable browser prototype and Roblox Luau project, including survival, progression, persistence, multiplayer support, and setup/testing guidance.

## Requirements
- Include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements, persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Keep Roblox gameplay server-authoritative; provide source, installation guidance, DataStore notes, and testing instructions.
- Work in stages and verify the project without clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implement both a browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Generate the Roblox island and resources in code, with a programmatic Roblox client UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Roblox project is organized under `roblox/`; browser UI and gameplay prototype are present.
- Browser gathering now increments `state.gathered` (including bonus fiber), missions use gathered totals, and saved gathered totals are restored and sanitized.
- Browser inventory rendering now includes crafted and built item definitions; level-ups no longer trigger an extra toast/sound during an action.

### Active
- Fix browser movement while panels are open and make reset robust when storage is unavailable; check remaining duplicate sound feedback.
- Review Roblox save sanitization and persistence risks; clarify unused recipe effects.
- Expand `README.md` with gameplay, launch, Roblox/Rojo installation, DataStore setup, and testing guidance.
- Run available checks and inspect final project status.

### Blocked
- Roblox runtime verification is unavailable; Luau, Rojo, Selene, and Stylua commands were not found.

## Next Move
1. Stop/clear browser movement while panels are open and make reset work when `localStorage` is unavailable.
2. Harden Roblox inventory sanitization to enforce aggregate `Config.MaxInventory`; validate crafted/mission keys and review save concurrency risks.
3. Align unused recipe descriptions/effects and expand `README.md` with browser and Roblox setup, DataStore, and testing instructions.
4. Run available checks and report project status and uncommitted changes.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Browser gameplay, gathered mission progress, inventory, input, saves, and sound.
- `README.md`: Needs project usage and setup documentation.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`: DataStore loading, profile sanitization, and saving.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-authoritative actions, inventory, buildings, survival, missions, and periodic saving.
- `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`: Roblox gameplay and progression definitions.
- `roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`: Roblox HUD and gameplay controls.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.
- `index.html`: Browser interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Browser layout and responsive styles.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked in git.
- Roblox inventory sanitization currently accepts arbitrary string keys in `Crafted` and `Missions`, and caps individual inventory entries without enforcing aggregate `Config.MaxInventory`.
- DataStore saving uses `UpdateAsync` to write the current snapshot; concurrent sessions/session locking remain a persistence risk to assess or document.
- Browser panel input can still move the player while a panel is open; reset handlers call `localStorage.removeItem` without guarding storage errors.
- Roblox runtime verification remains unavailable.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete “Survival Island” as a playable browser prototype and Roblox Luau project, including survival, progression, persistence, multiplayer support, and setup/testing guidance.

## Requirements
- Include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements, persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Keep Roblox gameplay server-authoritative; provide source, installation guidance, DataStore notes, and testing instructions.
- Work in stages and verify the project without clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implement both a browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Generate the Roblox island and resources in code, with a programmatic Roblox client UI.
- Document the Roblox persistence caveat: session locking is not implemented, so simultaneous sessions for the same user may overwrite saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Roblox project is organized under `roblox/`; browser UI and gameplay prototype are present.
- Browser gathering updates gathered totals, missions use gathered totals, and saved gathered totals are restored and sanitized.
- Browser inventory rendering includes crafted and built items; level-ups no longer trigger extra toast/sound feedback during actions.
- In `game.js`, opening a panel clears movement, movement is blocked while a panel is open, and modal close/Escape paths use `closePanel()`.
- Added a guarded `resetRun()` helper and connected the game-over reset to it.
- Updated browser spear/campfire descriptions to clarify their currently unimplemented combat/cooking effects.

### Active
- Finish guarding the main reset button against storage errors and remove duplicate sound feedback from the sound toggle.
- Harden Roblox save sanitization: enforce aggregate `Config.MaxInventory`, allowlist crafted/mission keys, and ensure levels remain at least 1.
- Clarify unused Roblox recipe effects and persistence/session-locking risks.
- Expand `README.md` with browser launch, Roblox/Rojo installation, DataStore setup, and testing guidance.
- Run available checks and inspect final project status.

### Blocked
- Roblox runtime verification is unavailable; `rojo`, `luau`, `selene`, and `stylua` were not found.

## Next Move
1. Complete browser reset guarding and sound feedback cleanup; verify modal movement and reset behavior.
2. Update Roblox sanitization and align recipe/UI descriptions with implemented effects.
3. Expand `README.md` with gameplay, launch, setup, DataStore caveats, and testing instructions.
4. Run available checks and summarize uncommitted changes and verification limits.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Browser gameplay, input, saves, sound, inventory, and reset handlers.
- `README.md`: Needs browser and Roblox setup/testing documentation.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`: Profile sanitization, DataStore loading/saving, and session persistence.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-authoritative actions, inventory, survival, missions, and periodic saving.
- `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`: Roblox gameplay and progression definitions.
- `roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`: Roblox HUD and gameplay controls.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.
- `index.html`: Browser interface and controls.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and currently untracked in git.
- Roblox inventory sanitization currently accepts arbitrary `Crafted` and `Missions` keys, caps each inventory item individually, and does not enforce the aggregate inventory limit.
- DataStore saving uses `UpdateAsync` to write the current snapshot; concurrent sessions/session locking remain a persistence risk.
- The game-over reset now uses guarded storage removal, but the main reset button still calls `localStorage.removeItem` directly.
- The sound toggle calls `playSound()` directly and then triggers another sound through `toast()`.

## Survival Island

This repository includes two playable versions of **Survival Island**:

- A browser prototype at the repository root (`index.html`, `game.js`, and `style.css`).
- A Roblox Studio project under `roblox/`, organized for [Rojo](https://rojo.space/).

Both versions include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, a shell currency/shop, missions, achievements/progression, and saving. The browser build saves locally in the current browser. Roblox gameplay actions and profile data are handled by server scripts.

### Play the browser prototype

Open `index.html` in a modern browser, or serve the project directory locally (recommended):

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then visit <http://localhost:8000>. Move with **WASD** or the arrow keys, or use the on-screen directional pad on a touch device. Click nearby resources to gather; use the Craft, Build, Missions, and Island Shop panels to progress. Browser progress is stored in this browser's local storage. **New Run** clears that save and reloads the game.

### Install the Roblox project

1. Install [Roblox Studio](https://create.roblox.com/) and [Rojo](https://rojo.space/docs/).
2. From the repository root, start the Rojo server:

   ```sh
   rojo serve roblox/default.project.json
   ```

3. In Roblox Studio, create or open a place, install the Rojo Studio plugin, and connect it to the running Rojo server. The project maps `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage`, `ServerScriptService`, and `StarterGui` into the corresponding Roblox services.
4. Press **Play** in Studio. The island, resources, remotes, and client HUD are created by the project scripts.

To export a place file instead of syncing through Studio, run `rojo build roblox/default.project.json -o /tmp/SurvivalIsland.rbxlx` and open the generated file in Studio.

### Roblox persistence and multiplayer notes

The Roblox server uses the DataStore named `SurvivalIsland_PlayerData_v1`. To test persistence against Roblox services, publish the experience and enable **Game Settings → Security → Enable Studio Access to API Services** for Studio testing. DataStores are unavailable in an unpublished local place; if loading fails, this project keeps gameplay locked rather than starting with a fresh profile that could overwrite saved progress. Test service access in a separate published test experience before using production data.

Saves are periodically written and saved when a player leaves or the server closes. **Session locking is not implemented**: if the same account joins multiple servers at once, concurrent saves may overwrite one another. Do not treat this prototype's persistence as conflict-safe production storage. Roblox resources are shared within a server; player inventories, needs, currency, missions, and buildings are stored per player.

### Testing checklist

- **Browser:** gather each resource, consume food/water, craft and build, complete missions, trade in the shop, reload to check local save restoration, and use New Run to verify reset behavior. Test movement and panel controls at desktop and mobile viewport sizes.
- **Roblox Studio:** use **Test → Start** with one or more players; gather with resource prompts, verify the axe's faster wood gathering, craft/build, consume supplies, complete missions, trade, and confirm the HUD updates. Stop and rejoin to check DataStore persistence in a published test place with API access enabled.
- In Roblox, the stone axe effect is implemented. The spear is recorded as crafted but combat is not implemented; the campfire is a crafted record only, without placement or cooking. The browser prototype displays its spear/campfire descriptions similarly.

The repository currently has no automated Roblox runtime test suite. Rojo/Studio checks require the corresponding Roblox tools and services; verify changes in Studio before publishing.

55: The Roblox server uses the DataStore named `SurvivalIsland_PlayerData_v1`. To test persistence against Roblox services, publish the experience and enable **Game Settings → Security → Enable Studio Access to API Services** for Studio testing. DataStores are unavailable in an unpublished local place; if loading fails, this project keeps gameplay locked rather than starting with a fresh profile that could overwrite saved progress. Test service access in a separate published test experience before using production data.
56: 
57: Saves are periodically written and saved when a player leaves or the server closes. **Session locking is not implemented**: if the same account joins multiple servers at once, concurrent saves may overwrite one another. Do not treat this prototype's persistence as conflict-safe production storage. Roblox resources are shared within a server; player inventories, needs, currency, missions, and buildings are stored per player.
58: 
59: ### Testing checklist
60: 
61: - **Browser:** gather each resource, consume food/water, craft and build, complete missions, trade in the shop, reload to check local save restoration, and use New Run to verify reset behavior. Test movement and panel controls at desktop and mobile viewport sizes.
62: - **Roblox Studio:** use **Test → Start** with one or more players; gather with resource prompts, verify the axe's faster wood gathering, craft/build, consume supplies, complete missions, trade, and confirm the HUD updates. Stop and rejoin to check DataStore persistence in a published test place with API access enabled.
63: - In Roblox, the stone axe effect is implemented. The spear is recorded as crafted but combat is not implemented; the campfire is a crafted record only, without placement or cooking. The browser prototype displays its spear/campfire descriptions similarly.
64: 
65: The repository currently has no automated Roblox runtime test suite. Rojo/Studio checks require the corresponding Roblox tools and services; verify changes in Studio before publishing.

## Objective
- Complete Survival Island as a playable browser prototype and Roblox Luau project, including survival, progression, persistence, multiplayer support, and setup/testing guidance.

## Requirements
- Include gathering, crafting, building, survival stats, inventory, shop/currency, missions, achievements/progression, persistence, and mobile-friendly controls.
- Keep Roblox gameplay server-authoritative; provide source, installation guidance, DataStore notes, and testing instructions.
- Work in stages and verify the project without clarification questions.

## Decisions
- Implement both a browser-playable prototype and a Rojo-organized Roblox project.
- Generate the Roblox island and resources in code, with a programmatic Roblox client UI.
- Document that session locking is not implemented and concurrent sessions may overwrite saves.
- Describe Roblox spear and campfire as crafted records without combat, placement, or cooking effects; the stone axe effect is implemented.

## Work State
### Completed
- Hardened browser reset paths against storage errors and removed duplicate sound-toggle feedback.
- Hardened Roblox profile sanitization with aggregate inventory limits, recipe/mission allowlists, and a minimum level of 1.
- Clarified Roblox recipe effects in the UI and corrected the craft-success message.
- Expanded `README.md` with browser launch, Rojo/Studio installation, DataStore setup and caveats, and testing guidance.
- `node --check game.js` and Rojo project JSON validation passed; `git diff --check` reported no issues for tracked changes.

### Active
- Final review and concise change/verification report.

### Blocked
- Roblox runtime verification is unavailable; `rojo`, `luau`, `selene`, and `stylua` are not installed.

## Next Move
1. Summarize the implemented changes and verification limits.
2. Recommend Studio testing before publishing, especially DataStore persistence and multiplayer behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `README.md`: Browser/Roblox setup, persistence caveats, and test checklist.
- `game.js`: Browser gameplay, reset, sound, input, and persistence handlers.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/DataService.lua`: Profile sanitization and persistence.
- `roblox/src/ServerScriptService/Services/GameService.lua`: Server-authoritative gameplay actions.
- `roblox/src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/Config.lua`: Roblox recipes, missions, and gameplay configuration.
- `roblox/src/StarterGui/SurvivalIsland.client.lua`: Roblox HUD and recipe descriptions.
- `roblox/default.project.json`: Rojo project mapping.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted. Most project files are untracked; `README.md` is modified.
- Roblox save writes use `UpdateAsync`, but session locking is not implemented; concurrent sessions for the same user may overwrite saves.
- Roblox DataStore testing requires a published experience with Studio API access enabled.
